response.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_large_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_txn_count FROM trans WHERE amount > 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY large_txn_count DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A large transaction is one with amount strictly greater than 2400 (the cutoff itself is not counted), regardless of transaction type (PRIJEM, VYDAJ or VYBER), since the request does not restrict direction.
Ties at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, since the request gives no tie-break rule.

alternatives.interpretation: A large transaction is one with amount at or above 2400 (inclusive cutoff).
alternatives.sql: SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) AS avg_large_amount, COUNT(*) AS large_txn_count FROM trans WHERE amount >= 2400 GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY large_txn_count DESC LIMIT 10;
